title: hieracium vulgatum subsp. festinum
intro: Hieracium vulgatum subsp. festinum, commonly known as Field Hawkweed, is a species of flowering plant in the dandelion family (Asteraceae). It has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health issues, including digestive problems, skin conditions, and respiratory issues, due to its multiple health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Hieracium vulgatum subsp. festinum are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which help to soothe and heal damaged tissues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, sesquiterpenes, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
